notes: Costa Rica: only 8 entries (4 x 24 h: Hospital PETS+ San Antonio, Petopia, La Vete Escazu, La Vete Curridabat; HEMS-UNA is not 24 h). Most clinics' own sites could not be opened: the fetch tool only opens URLs that surfaced in search results, and many clinic domains never did; some sites refused automated access (cavallinivet.com robots-disallowed, alltama.com robots-disallowed, medipetcr.com failed). No national or regional duty rota (guardia) found. No animal poison information line found: the Colegio de Medicos Veterinarios de Costa Rica website and any SENASA clinic directory could not be located or opened, and no official page naming an animal poison line was found (the human poison centre was not confirmed to take animal calls). Not done (24-h claims seen only in the vet24cr.com directory, not on own pages, so NOT added): Hospital Veterinario Cavallini (Tamarindo), Hospital Veterinario Santamaria (Alajuela), Hospital Veterinario Medical Care (Heredia), Hospital Veterinario Drs. Chacon (Guadalupe), VitalVet Cartago (El Tejar), Clinica Veterinaria San Juan (La Union), Veterinaria SALVET 24 (Cartago), Medical Pets (Cartago, Curridabat), Nuske Vet Center (Esparza), Guanavet (Liberia), IVDSA Santa Ana / Tres Rios, Hospital Veterinario Agromedica (Escazu), Clinica Veterinaria Ramirez (San Rafael de Heredia), Veterinaria Donde Chiza (Santa Cruz), Clinica Veterinaria Villa Mascotas (San Vito), Veterinaria Gocha (Santo Domingo de Heredia). Other leads without own page opened: Medipet Hotel y Hospital Veterinario, Veterinaria Argos, Pet Cafe, Pets Avenue, Innovavet, Exoplanet, La Vete Herradura (phone 2102 7028 on contact page, no 24 h claim), La Vete Alajuela/San Pablo/other branches (no addresses), Medismart network. Regions with no entries: Alajuela, Cartago, Guanacaste (Liberia, Tamarindo, Playas del Coco), Puntarenas/Jaco/Manuel Antonio/Quepos, Limon/Puerto Viejo, La Fortuna. Hospital Veterinario San Antonio (hospitalveterinariosanantonio.com) is in Tenerife, Spain, not Costa Rica. Rescate Wildlife Zoave (La Garita, 2433 8989) is a wildlife rescue with daytime hours only, not added. Follow-up 2026-11-11 added 11 entries (Agromedica Escazu, Agromedica San Rafael de Alajuela, Ganagro, Medical Pets Cartago and Curridabat, IVDSA Santa Ana and Tres Rios, VitalVet Cartago, Clinica San Juan Tres Rios, Clinica San Rafael Heredia, Nuske Esparza); 24 h entries are now 10 in total (Medical Pets, IVDSA, VitalVet, San Juan, Agromedica Escazu added). Still unreachable or not done: robots-blocked (skipped, not retried): Hospital Veterinario Santamaria Alajuela, Hospital Veterinario Medical Care Heredia, Cavallini Tamarindo, All Tama (alltama.com), Cavaj Vet (cavajvet.com), Clinica Monte de la Cruz (montedelacruz.com); no own site surfaced in search (Facebook/directory listings only, not used): Guanavet and other Liberia clinics (Solera Animal Center, Amigos por los Animales), SALVET 24 / SALVET CVA Cartago, Drs. Chacon Guadalupe (24 h claim only on directories), Medical Care, Medical Pets Paraiso, Donde Chiza, Villa Mascotas San Vito, Gocha, Jaco clinics (Jaco Vetcenter, Jaco Pets), Quepos clinics (Dr. Alfaro, Dr. Delgado), Puerto Viejo/Cahuita (Coral Vet has only Facebook/Instagram, Green Vet, Centro de Mascotas), Nosara (Safari Vet, Nosaravet), Santa Cruz, Guapiles/Siquirres/Limon centre, La Fortuna (no clinic with an own site found; search hits were in Spain), Tamarindo (no clinics registered locally besides Cavallini). La Vete nosotros page lists Alajuela, Escazu, San Francisco, San Pablo and Curridabat branches without addresses; its 24 h text ties only to Escazu (Curridabat per contact page). Jaguar Rescue Center (Puerto Viejo) hospital is wildlife-focused, not added. Official body: Colegio de Medicos Veterinarios and SENASA sites still not found or opened by search; no duty rota and no animal poison line found.
